d:
Relive the magic of love with “Tu Jaane Naa” in stunning 8K resolution, from the Bollywood romantic blockbuster Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani. Sung by the soulful Atif Aslam, composed by Pritam, this timeless romantic melody beautifully captures the emotions of unspoken love and heartbreak.
Song Credits :
Singer(s) - Atif Aslam
Lyrics Writer - Irshad Kamil
Music Director - Pritam
Movie Cast & Crew :
Producer : Ramesh S. Taurani
Director : Rajkumar Santoshi
